title: Compose and publish Deep House score: Funky Nurykabe
description: Compose and publish a warm, hypnotic 122 BPM Deep House score built around jlbrock44/260809-Funky-Nurykabe_29186.mp3 loop-1 and vocal/sub layers over a classic 4-on-the-floor deep house pocket.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Composed, auditioned, and published Deep House: Funky Nurykabe (122 BPM, Cm) built around jlbrock44/260809-Funky-Nurykabe_29186.mp3 loop-1. Classic deep house 4-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hats, syncopated chord stabs with smooth filter automations, walking sub bass notes over a 4-bar progression (Cm7 -> Abmaj7 -> Fm7 -> Gm7), and lush shared reverb and dub echo. Published to cloud storage as scr_scores_Deep House: Funky Nurykabe_apr.

right_now_summary: The 122 BPM Deep House score was composed, auditioned, and published to cloud storage.
